question: Which plugin must be activated before installing the Field Service Management Virtual Conferencing Integration application?

options.text: Notify (com.snc.notify)
Service Portal (com.glide.service-portal)
Agent Workspace (com.snc.agent_workspace)
Flow Designer (com.glide.process-automation)

explanation.correct: The Notify plugin (com.snc.notify) is a required prerequisite that must be activated before installing FSM Virtual Conferencing Integration. Notify provides support for SMS and voice channels on the platform, which is essential for virtual conferencing functionality.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Service Portal is not listed as a prerequisite for FSM Virtual Conferencing Integration. The required plugin is Notify.
Agent Workspace is not a required prerequisite for FSM Virtual Conferencing Integration. The documentation specifically lists Notify as the required plugin.
Flow Designer is not mentioned as a prerequisite for FSM Virtual Conferencing Integration. Notify is the required plugin that must be activated first.

source.excerpt: Field Service Management Virtual Confering Integration requires the following plugins. Ensure that these plugins are activated before you install Field Service Management Virtual Conferencing Integration. Notify (com.snc.notify) - Provides support for SMS and voice channels on the platform.

question: When integrating Field Service Management with Customer Service Management, which two fields on the Work Order form automatically update related fields? (Choose two.)

options.text: Account field updates the Company field
Contact field updates the Caller field
Priority field updates the Urgency field
Asset field updates the Configuration Item field
Consumer field updates the Customer field

explanation.correct: According to the CSM-FSM integration documentation, updating the Account field on the Work Order form also updates the Company field, and updating the Contact field on the Work Order form updates the Caller field. These automatic field synchronizations ensure data consistency between related records.

wrongAnswers.explanation: There is no documented automatic synchronization between Priority and Urgency fields in the CSM-FSM integration. The integration specifically handles Account-to-Company and Contact-to-Caller mappings.
Asset field does not automatically update the Configuration Item field as part of the CSM-FSM integration. The documented automatic updates are Account-to-Company and Contact-to-Caller.
Consumer field does not automatically update a Customer field. The documented field synchronizations are Account updating Company and Contact updating Caller.

source.excerpt: Updating the Account field on the Work Order form also updates the Company field. Updating the Contact field on the Work Order form updates the Caller field.

question: Which task is NOT included in the Work Order Task Types category of the Field Service Management guided setup?

options.text: Set Up View Rules
Set Up Business Rules
Set Up SLA Definitions
Set Up ACLs

explanation.correct: Set Up SLA Definitions is not listed as a task in the Work Order Task Types category of the guided setup. The guided setup includes tasks for View Rules, UI Policies, Client Scripts, Business Rules, UI Actions, Roles, ACLs, Work Categories, Work Types, SM Config, and Work Configuration.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Set Up View Rules is included in the guided setup. View rules determine the form views that are available to users and when the system displays the Work Order Task Type table in a specified view.
Set Up Business Rules is part of the guided setup. Business rules are server-side scripts that run when records are displayed, inserted, updated, or deleted.
Set Up ACLs is included in the guided setup. Access Control List rules (ACLs) are used to restrict access to data for the Work Order Task Type.

source.excerpt: In the Work order task types category, view the list of tasks to configure the feature: Create Work Order Task Types, Set Up View Rules, Set Up UI Policies, Set Up Client Scripts, Set Up Business Rules, Set Up UI Actions, Set Up Roles, Set Up ACLs, Set Up Work Categories, Set Up Work Types, Set up Field Service Management Configuration (SM Config), Set Up Work Configuration.

question: A company wants to implement virtual conferencing capabilities in Field Service Management using Microsoft Teams. Which two ServiceNow Store applications must be installed to support this integration?

options.text: Microsoft Teams Spoke and Azure AD Integration
Notify Connector for Microsoft Teams and Microsoft Teams Communication Spoke
Microsoft Graph API Spoke and Teams Webhook Integration
Office 365 Spoke and Microsoft Teams Notifications

explanation.correct: To integrate Microsoft Teams with FSM Virtual Conferencing, two specific ServiceNow Store applications are required: Notify Connector for Microsoft Teams (to manage and initiate Teams meetings directly from a task) and Microsoft Teams Communication Spoke (to manage group calls and meetings in Microsoft Communications account from ServiceNow).

wrongAnswers.explanation: Microsoft Teams Spoke and Azure AD Integration are not the required applications for FSM Virtual Conferencing. The correct applications are Notify Connector for Microsoft Teams and Microsoft Teams Communication Spoke.

Microsoft Graph API Spoke and Teams Webhook Integration are not listed as requirements for FSM Virtual Conferencing with Microsoft Teams. The documentation specifies Notify Connector for Microsoft Teams and Microsoft Teams Communication Spoke.
Office 365 Spoke and Microsoft Teams Notifications are not the required applications. FSM Virtual Conferencing requires Notify Connector for Microsoft Teams and Microsoft Teams Communication Spoke.

source.excerpt: Required ServiceNow Store applications to integrate Microsoft Teams: Notify Connector for Microsoft Teams - Manage and initiate a Microsoft Teams meeting directly from a task. Microsoft Teams Communication Spoke - Manage groups calls and meetings in Microsoft Communications account from your ServiceNow instance.

question: Which three statements are true about the Customer Service Management and Field Service Management integration? (Choose three.)

options.text: Work order creation from a case automatically includes case-related information
Changes on the Case form are automatically synchronized to the Work Order form
Customers can view case-related work orders from the Customer Service Portal
The integration adds a Work Orders link to the Customer Service Portal header
Field mappings between case and work order tables cannot be customized

explanation.correct: The CSM-FSM integration provides these capabilities: (1) when an agent creates a work order from a case, the work order includes case-related information such as account and contact; (2) customers can view details of work orders related to their cases from the Customer Service Portal; and (3) the integration adds a Work Orders link to the Customer Service Portal and Consumer Service Portal headers.

wrongAnswers.explanation: This is false. The documentation explicitly states a known limitation: 'There is no synchronization between the Work Order form and the associated Case form. If information changes on the Case form, it does not get updated on the Work Order form.'
This is false. The documentation states that users can 'Define the fields you want to map between the case and the target work order table fields.' Field mappings are configurable.

source.excerpt: When an agent creates a work order from a customer service case, the work order and task forms include case-related information. When a customer or a consumer views a case from either the Customer or Consumer Service Portals, they can view the details of any work orders and tasks related to the case. This integration adds the Work Orders link to the Customer Service Portal and Consumer Service Portal headers. Known limitations: There is no synchronization between the Work Order form and the associated Case form.
